text:
nina_r: Planning a config-only push in the 23:30-00:30 PDT change window. Targets: tighten per-tenant burst_limit from 200->150, reduce max_batch_tokens 2048->1536, decrease idle batch window 12ms->6ms, routing: shift small fraction from model-alpha->model-beta for cost smoothing. No model binaries changed.

nina_r: Patch excerpt:
```
quota:
  tenant_burst: 200 -> 150
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048 -> 1536
  idle_window_ms: 12 -> 6
routing:
  model-alpha: 0.95 -> 0.92
  model-beta: 0.05 -> 0.08
```

ops_miguel: Heads-up: tenant-payments (tenant-88) and tenant-legacy-chat (tenant-13) have heavy tail latency during bursts. Recommend sticky pins to keep them on model-alpha during rollout.

nina_r: Agreed. Will pin tenant-88 and tenant-13 for the rollout. Also enabling circuit-breaker for burst-limit-exceed events (soft-fail to queue).

deploy-bot: Initiating config roll cfg-2026-04-06-174560 -> canary 3% now. Watching: p50/p95, error-rate, throttled-429s, queue-depth, evictions.

eng_tom: Set thresholds: increase in 429s > 0.2% OR p95 delta > 200ms => roll back. Also if queue-depth > 2x baseline for 5m, roll back.

sre_oncall: I'll add exclusion pins. Command I ran:
```bash
redwood routing pin --tenant tenant-88 --model model-alpha --until 2026-04-07T00:30:00Z
redwood routing pin --tenant tenant-13 --model model-alpha --until 2026-04-07T00:30:00Z
```

product_zoe: Any customer-impact notes for Support?

nina_r: Minimal. Could see slightly fewer token bursts allowed per request, but graceful queueing should avoid 5xx. Inform support to watch for 429s and long queue-times.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 15% at 23:40 PDT. Quick metrics: 429s +0.05%, p95 +18ms, queue-depth +8%. All green.

ops_miguel: Noting one tenant, tenant-504, is hitting quota ceiling at 15% - p95 +120ms. Recommend temporary pin for tenant-504 while we observe.

eng_tom: Pin tenant-504. Also enable short-circuit fallback for that tenant to older batching policy if p95 > 350ms.

sre_oncall: Pinned tenant-504 to model-alpha until 2026-04-07T00:30Z.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 50% at 23:48 PDT. Observability: regional spike in us-west2 p95 ~ +90ms for 3m then recovered. No 429 surge.

eng_tom: us-west2 blip looks like transient node restart triggering kvcache warmup. Keep watch, but not a rollback yet.

product_zoe: I'll draft a short support note: "Config tuning to improve latency/cost. Certain tenants temporarily pinned; support monitor 429s and p95"

deploy-bot: Moving to 100% at 00:05 PDT. Final snapshot: global 429s +0.07%, p95 +35ms, queue-depth +10%. No thresholds breached.

nina_r: Leaving pins until 24h verification. Opening follow-up: INFRA-1299 "unpin tenants after cfg-2026-04-06". Also added post-deploy smoke eval at 00:40 PDT.

eng_tom: Quick rollback command in runbook:
```bash
redwood deploy rollback --config-id cfg-2026-04-06-174560 --reason "burst-limit regressions / sustained queues"
```

ops_miguel: Post-deploy eval started. Running the representative prompt set against model-beta path to ensure no semantic regressions due to batching token window change.

deploy-bot: Post-deploy eval complete at 00:45 PDT. Result: generation-quality parity check passed (all prompts within expected similarity thresholds).

product_zoe: I'll add a line to release notes: "Config-only: tighter per-tenant burst limits, smaller batches, reduced idle batching latency, minor routing weight shift. No API changes."

eng_tom: Leaving monitoring alarms at heightened sensitivity for next 6 hours. Escalate to #eng-oncall and tag me for any alerts.

nina_r: Thanks all. We'll unpin tenants in INFRA-1299 after 24h if metrics stable. Closing thread; will post final metric dump to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
